note: Synthetic tickets for the Support agent (ADR 0021 Phase 2, WP2.7): 12 triage, 6 draft, 4 hand-off and 4 injection cases. No real customer data. The offline test checks the deterministic parts (hard rules on subject and message, draft checks, the agent's locked rules and the dry-run worst case); a paid live run needs Mario's approval (cap USD 3, OpenAI per D-11).
